text:
olivia.partnerships: FYI partner Vertex hit an arch snag during marketplace onboarding — they ran into SNI/cert pinning + HSM constraints that break our telemetry proxy. Need quick arch review + mitigation. Attaching the partner ticket and snips of the TLS errors.

sam_solutions: Can you paste the exact error from their side or link the ticket?

vertex-mike: Ticket is VERT-889. From our SIEM forwarder: "502 TLS handshake failure" when routed through marketplace NAT. Works if we bypass the marketplace. We use customer-managed KMS for client cert signing.

arjun_eng: Quick triage: marketplace NAT currently terminates some TLS flows to inject telemetry headers which strips SNI when client does cert pinning. If partner uses mutual TLS and pins certs, the proxy flow breaks. Possible quick fix is to allow passthrough for those destinations.

maria_sec: Any passthrough change must preserve HSM/KMS isolation — we can't let private keys be proxied into our control plane. Also need audit logs for the exception.

olivia.partnerships: Goal: unblock go-live next week. Options: 1) short-term: explicit egress allowlist for partner SIEM IPs (manual, timeboxed) 2) medium: implement SNI-preserving NAT/path 3) long-term: update marketplace connector to support client cert chaining. Need decision + owners.

sam_solutions: I can own option 1. I'll coordinate the change window and communicate to the partner. @arjun_eng can you sketch the infra change? @maria_sec can you confirm compliance constraints?

arjun_eng: I pushed an initial PR w/ example iptables rule and a tiny terraform snippet to create an allowlist and a short-lived route in staging. Snippet (very simplified):
\n```\n# iptables sample for passthrough to partner IP\n-A PREROUTING -p tcp -d 203.0.113.45 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT\n```\nAnd a terraform placeholder to create an allowlist tag on the NAT gateway. I'll test in staging in the next 2 hours.

vertex-mike: We'll share the exact dest IPs and the client cert fingerprints. We don't want a permanent exception — prefer a canary window and then a connector update.

maria_sec: Manual allowlist is acceptable under the customer's SLA if we: 1) timebox to 7 days, 2) emit audit events to the Console, 3) export KMS/HSM access logs to a compliance bucket. Legal should review dataflow. +1 with those caveats.

olivia.partnerships: Plan: sam raises a change with 7d expiry, arjun deploys staging rule and confirms TLS handshake there, vertex validates end-to-end, maria does sign-off and config for audit export. If staging fails, escalate to eng-runtime for SNI-preserving NAT. I'll own coordination and timeline.

sam_solutions: :thumbsup: raising CHG-4521 now — https://inc.change/chg-4521 (will add partner IPs + expiry).

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-nat-allowlist at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z — CI checks required.

arjun_eng: Staging test completed, handshake looks good. Logs: \n```\nHandshake succeeded: cipher=TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; peer_fingerprint=AB:CD:EF:01:23\n```\nI'll hold prod deploy pending maria sign-off.

maria_sec: Approved with audit notes. Please ensure KMS audit log export is enabled and linked to the partner's compliance bucket. Also set the allowlist to auto-revoke after 7 days. +eyes

vertex-mike: Confirmed — SIEM now receives logs in staging. We'll run a small canary ingestion tomorrow morning and report back. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

olivia.partnerships: Great job. We'll capture this flow in the partner onboarding runbook and open a follow-up ticket to add client-cert chaining support to the marketplace connector for the next sprint. :tada:
